unit.title: A compliment or a joke?
unit.titleZh: 你刚才究竟是什么意思
canDo: Check the intended meaning of an ambiguous remark
Distinguish an impression from a confirmed fact
Repair a misunderstanding without turning it into an argument

example.zh: 她暗示自己想早点回家。
example.py: tā àn shì zì jǐ xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā .
example.en: She hinted that she wanted to go home early.

example.en: What this sentence means depends on what came before it.

grammar.explanation: Place 却 before the second predicate. It usually connects a result that conflicts with the first expectation. It does not automatically mean the result is negative.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng bāng máng , què yuè bāng yuè máng .
examples.en: I wanted to help but ended up making more work.

examples.zh: 天气很好，她却不想出门。
examples.py: tiān qì hěn hǎo , tā què bù xiǎng chū mén .
examples.en: The weather is lovely, yet she doesn’t want to go out.

commonMistakes.wrong: 却天气很好，她不想出门。
commonMistakes.right: 天气很好，她却不想出门。
commonMistakes.why: 却 belongs with the contrasted predicate, not before the topic of the first clause.

grammar.purpose: Ask for the exact unresolved point
grammar.explanation: 究竟 strengthens a genuine question with 谁、什么、哪里、为什么 or a choice. Context and delivery determine whether it sounds curious or impatient.

examples.py: piào jiū jìng fàng zài nǎ lǐ le ?
examples.en: Where exactly did you put the tickets?

examples.py: nǐ jiū jìng xiǎng zuò nǎ yī bān chē ?
examples.en: Which train do you actually want to take?

commonMistakes.why: A specific-choice question does not add 吗.

grammar.purpose: Set the topic of an attitude or assessment
grammar.explanation: 对于 introduces what an attitude, opinion or evaluation concerns. In casual conversation, 关于、对 and a plain topic can overlap; do not force 对于 into every sentence.

examples.zh: 对于这个安排，你有什么意见？
examples.py: duì yú zhè gè ān pái , nǐ yǒu shén me yì jiàn ?
examples.en: What do you think of this arrangement?

examples.zh: 对于第一次来的朋友，这张图很有用。
examples.py: duì yú dì yī cì lái de péng you , zhè zhāng tú hěn yǒu yòng .
examples.en: This map is useful for friends visiting for the first time.

commonMistakes.why: 对于 introduces a topic or target of an attitude, not direction of movement.

grammar.explanation: 的确 endorses a claim; 似乎 presents an impression rather than certainty. A speaker can revise either after learning more.

examples.py: zhè jiā de miàn dí què hěn hǎo chī .
examples.en: The noodles here really are good.

examples.zh: 他似乎没听懂，我再说一次吧。
examples.py: tā sì hū méi tīng dǒng , wǒ zài shuō yī cì ba .
examples.en: He seems not to have understood; I’ll say it again.

commonMistakes.wrong: 他似乎没听懂，所以我已经确定他不懂。
commonMistakes.right: 他似乎没听懂，我再问问。
commonMistakes.why: 似乎 does not itself establish certainty.

dialogue.title: 你刚才究竟是什么意思
dialogue.titleZh: 你刚才究竟是什么意思
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你刚才说我的外套很特别，究竟是什么意思？
lines.py: nǐ gāng cái shuō wǒ de wài tào hěn tè bié , jiū jìng shì shén me yì si ?
lines.en: When you said my coat was unusual, what exactly did you mean?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就是颜色很好看。怎么了？
lines.py: jiù shì yán sè hěn hǎo kàn . zěn me le ?
lines.en: Just that the colour is lovely. What’s wrong?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你的表情太认真了，我以为你在说不好看。
lines.py: nǐ de biǎo qíng tài rèn zhēn le , wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ zài shuō bù hǎo kàn .
lines.en: You looked so serious that I thought you meant it looked bad.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我真是在称赞你。我这个人一紧张就不太会笑。
lines.py: wǒ zhēn shì zài chēng zàn nǐ . wǒ zhè gè rén yī jǐn zhāng jiù bù tài huì xiào .
lines.en: I really was complimenting you. I find it hard to smile when I’m nervous.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你也紧张？我还以为只有我这样。
lines.py: nǐ yě jǐn zhāng ? wǒ hái yǐ wéi zhǐ yǒu wǒ zhè yàng .
lines.en: You get nervous too? I thought it was just me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 当然。刚才我差点叫错你的名字。
lines.py: dāng rán . gāng cái wǒ chà diǎn jiào cuò nǐ de míng zi .
lines.en: Of course. I almost called you by the wrong name just now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好吧，那是我误会了。谢谢你的称赞。
lines.py: hǎo ba , nà shì wǒ wù huì le . xiè xiè nǐ de chēng zàn .
lines.en: Okay, I misunderstood. Thanks for the compliment.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不要紧。说实话，你不喜欢别人评论你的衣服吗？
lines.py: bú yào jǐn . shuō shí huà , nǐ bù xǐ huān bié ren píng lùn nǐ de yī fú ma ?
lines.en: No problem. Honestly, do you dislike people commenting on your clothes?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不在乎，只是我今天自己也觉得这个颜色太亮了。
lines.py: bù zài hū , zhǐ shì wǒ jīn tiān zì jǐ yě jué de zhè gè yán sè tài liàng le .
lines.en: I don’t mind. It’s just that I already thought the colour was too bright today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是挺亮的。我刚到门口，一下就找到你了。
lines.py: shì tǐng liàng de . wǒ gāng dào mén kǒu , yī xià jiù zhǎo dào nǐ le .
lines.en: It is bright. I spotted you as soon as I arrived at the door.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你这次是在开玩笑，对吧？
lines.py: nǐ zhè cì shì zài kāi wán xiào , duì ba ?
lines.en: This time you’re joking, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。不过你的确很好找。我们先进去吧。
lines.py: duì . bù guò nǐ dí què hěn hǎo zhǎo . wǒ men xiān jìn qù ba .
lines.en: Yes. But you really are easy to spot. Let’s go in.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why does the guest ask about the coat comment?
choices: They aren’t sure whether it was a compliment
They want to borrow the coat
They cannot find their coat
questions.answer: They aren’t sure whether it was a compliment

questions.q: Why does the speaker look serious?
choices: They find it hard to smile when nervous
They are deliberately criticising the guest
They have already left
questions.answer: They find it hard to smile when nervous

questions.q: What supports the second remark being teasing?
choices: The listener checks and the speaker confirms it is a joke
Every serious expression means a joke
The speaker refuses to explain
questions.answer: The listener checks and the speaker confirms it is a joke

reading.title: 你刚才究竟是什么意思
reading.titleZh: 你刚才究竟是什么意思
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 以前，朋友说“你可真行”，我总以为是在表扬我。后来有一天，我把大家的车票忘在家里，他又说了这句话。
lines.py: yǐ qián , péng you shuō nǐ kě zhēn xíng , wǒ zǒng yǐ wéi shì zài biǎo yáng wǒ . hòu lái yǒu yī tiān , wǒ bǎ dà jiā de chē piào wàng zài jiā lǐ , tā yòu shuō le zhè jù huà .
lines.en: When friends used to say “You’re really something,” I always thought it was praise. Then one day I left everyone’s tickets at home, and a friend said it again.

lines.zh: 我先笑了，看到他手里的空袋子才发现不对。原来，同样几个字，在不同的情况下，含义可能完全不同。
lines.py: wǒ xiān xiào le , kàn dào tā shǒu lǐ de kōng dài zi cái fā xiàn bú duì . yuán lái , tóng yàng jǐ gè zì , zài bù tóng de qíng kuàng xià , hán yì kě néng wán quán bù tóng .
lines.en: I smiled at first, then noticed the empty bag in his hand and realised something was wrong. The same few words can mean quite different things in different situations.

lines.zh: 他没有发火，只问我究竟把票放在哪里。我承认自己出门前没检查，马上打车回去拿。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu fā huǒ , zhǐ wèn wǒ jiū jìng bǎ piào fàng zài nǎ lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ chū mén qián méi jiǎn chá , mǎ shàng dǎ chē huí qù ná .
lines.en: He didn’t lose his temper, just asked where exactly I’d put the tickets. I admitted I hadn’t checked before leaving and immediately took a taxi home to collect them.

lines.zh: 回来以后，我想解释自己为什么会忘，朋友却先递给我一瓶水，说：“先喝口水，我们还有时间。”
lines.py: huí lái yǐ hòu , wǒ xiǎng jiě shì zì jǐ wèi shén me huì wàng , péng you què xiān dì gěi wǒ yī píng shuǐ , shuō : xiān hē kǒu shuǐ , wǒ men hái yǒu shí jiān .
lines.en: When I got back, I wanted to explain why I’d forgotten, but my friend handed me some water first and said, “Have a drink first. We still have time.”

lines.zh: 这次我没有急着猜他是不是生气。我先道歉，再问他刚才那句话是不是在开玩笑。他笑着说，一半是玩笑，一半是真的着急。
lines.py: zhè cì wǒ méi yǒu jí zhe cāi tā shì bú shì shēng qì . wǒ xiān dào qiàn , zài wèn tā gāng cái nà jù huà shì bú shì zài kāi wán xiào . tā xiào zhe shuō , yí bàn shì wán xiào , yí bàn shì zhēn de zháo jí .
lines.en: This time I didn’t rush to guess whether he was angry. I apologised first, then asked whether his earlier remark was a joke. He laughed and said it was half a joke and half genuine worry.

lines.zh: 对于不太了解的表达，我现在会看前后的事情，也会直接问。不明白未必是自己的中文太差，有时连熟悉的人也会听错。
lines.py: duì yú bù tài liǎo jiě de biǎo dá , wǒ xiàn zài huì kàn qián hòu de shì qíng , yě huì zhí jiē wèn . bù míng bái wèi bì shì zì jǐ de zhōng wén tài chà , yǒu shí lián shú xī de rén yě huì tīng cuò .
lines.en: When I don’t understand an expression well, I now look at the surrounding events and ask directly. Not understanding doesn’t necessarily mean my Chinese is poor; even people who know each other can mishear things.

choices: The meaning of a remark depends on its situation
Every remark containing 真 is praise
Questions should never be asked
questions.answer: The meaning of a remark depends on its situation

choices: Everyone’s tickets
A bottle of water
The taxi address

questions.q: Why offer water before hearing the explanation?
choices: The friend is helping them calm down while time remains
The friend has cancelled the journey
The friend has forgotten the tickets too
questions.answer: The friend is helping them calm down while time remains

extraReadings.title: The tickets are still at home
extraReadings.titleZh: The tickets are still at home
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你可真行，票呢？
lines.py: nǐ kě zhēn xíng , piào ne ?
lines.en: You’re really something. Where are the tickets?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在……等一下，我包里怎么没有？
lines.py: zài děng yī xià , wǒ bāo lǐ zěn me méi yǒu ?
lines.en: In… hang on, why aren’t they in my bag?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你别告诉我，它们还在桌上。
lines.py: nǐ bié gào sù wǒ , tā men hái zài zhuō shàng .
lines.en: Don’t tell me they’re still on the table.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我承认，应该还在桌上。你等我一下。
lines.py: wǒ chéng rèn , yīng gāi hái zài zhuō shàng . nǐ děng wǒ yī xià .
lines.en: I admit they’re probably still on the table. Wait a moment.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先别跑，车还有半小时才开。我们一起想想办法。
lines.py: xiān bié pǎo , chē hái yǒu bàn xiǎo shí cái kāi . wǒ men yì qǐ xiǎng xiǎng bàn fǎ .
lines.en: Don’t run off yet. The train doesn’t leave for another half hour. Let’s work out what to do.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你不生气？
lines.py: nǐ bù shēng qì ?
lines.en: You’re not angry?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 生气也不能把票变出来啊。你先打电话问问家里有人没有。
lines.py: shēng qì yě bù néng bǎ piào biàn chū lái a . nǐ xiān dǎ diàn huà wèn wèn jiā lǐ yǒu rén méi yǒu .
lines.en: Getting angry won’t make the tickets appear. Call and see whether anyone’s home first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。今天我请你吃饭，先补偿一下。
lines.py: hǎo . jīn tiān wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn , xiān bǔ cháng yī xià .
lines.en: Okay. Dinner’s on me today, to make it up to you.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Half an hour
Five minutes
Two hours
Find a practical way to get the tickets
Argue until the train leaves
Pretend the tickets are unnecessary
questions.answer: Find a practical way to get the tickets

extraReadings.title: A compliment or a joke?: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 你刚才究竟是什么意思 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 她暗示自己想早点回家。
lines.py: tā àn shì zì jǐ xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā .
lines.en: She hinted that she wanted to go home early.

lines.zh: 他没直接说价格，只暗示可能很贵。
lines.py: tā méi zhí jiē shuō jià gé , zhǐ àn shì kě néng hěn guì .
lines.en: He didn’t name a price, only hinted that it might be expensive.

lines.zh: 这句话的含义要看前面说了什么。

lines.en: Does this name have a special meaning?

lines.zh: 你究竟想周五去，还是周六去？
lines.py: nǐ jiū jìng xiǎng zhōu wǔ qù , hái shi zhōu liù qù ?
lines.en: Do you actually want to go on Friday or Saturday?

lines.zh: 我想知道他们究竟为什么吵架。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào tā men jiū jìng wèi shén me chǎo jià .
lines.en: I want to know exactly why they argued.

lines.zh: 贵的东西未必更好。
lines.py: guì de dōng xi wèi bì gèng hǎo .
lines.en: Expensive things aren’t necessarily better.

lines.zh: 不说话未必是生气。
lines.py: bù shuō huà wèi bì shì shēng qì .
lines.en: Being quiet doesn’t necessarily mean being angry.

lines.zh: 这家店的面的确很好吃。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn dí què hěn hǎo chī .
lines.en: The noodles here really are good.

lines.zh: 你的办法的确省时间。
lines.py: nǐ de bàn fǎ dí què shěng shí jiān .
lines.en: Your method really does save time.

lines.zh: 他竟然记得我去年说过的话。
lines.py: tā jìng rán jì de wǒ qù nián shuō guò de huà .
lines.en: He actually remembered what I’d said last year.

lines.zh: 我竟然把钥匙放进冰箱了。
lines.py: wǒ jìng rán bǎ yào shi fàng jìn bīng xiāng le .
lines.en: Somehow I put my keys in the fridge.

lines.zh: 我想帮忙，却越帮越忙。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bāng máng , què yuè bāng yuè máng .
lines.en: I wanted to help but ended up making more work.

lines.zh: 天气很好，她却不想出门。
lines.py: tiān qì hěn hǎo , tā què bù xiǎng chū mén .
lines.en: The weather was lovely, yet she didn’t want to go out.

lines.zh: 对于这个安排，你有什么意见？
lines.py: duì yú zhè gè ān pái , nǐ yǒu shén me yì jiàn ?
lines.en: What do you think of this arrangement?

lines.zh: 对于第一次来的朋友，地图很有用。
lines.py: duì yú dì yī cì lái de péng you , dì tú hěn yǒu yòng .
lines.en: A map is useful for friends visiting for the first time.

lines.zh: 他似乎没听懂我的问题。
lines.py: tā sì hū méi tīng dǒng wǒ de wèn tí .
lines.en: He seems not to have understood my question.

lines.zh: 雨似乎停了，我们出去看看吧。
lines.py: yǔ sì hū tíng le , wǒ men chū qù kàn kàn ba .
lines.en: It seems to have stopped raining. Let’s check outside.

lines.zh: 我承认，刚才是我看错了。
lines.py: wǒ chéng rèn , gāng cái shì wǒ kàn cuò le .
lines.en: I admit I read it wrong just now.

lines.zh: 他终于承认自己忘了报名。
lines.py: tā zhōng yú chéng rèn zì jǐ wàng le bào míng .
lines.en: He finally admitted he’d forgotten to register.

lines.zh: 请诚实地告诉我，菜是不是太咸了？
lines.py: qǐng chéng shí de gào sù wǒ , cài shì bú shì tài xián le ?
lines.en: Tell me honestly: is the food too salty?

lines.zh: 她很诚实，捡到钱马上交给了老师。
lines.py: tā hěn chéng shí , jiǎn dào qián mǎ shàng jiāo gěi le lǎo shī .
lines.en: She was honest and immediately gave the money she found to the teacher.

lines.zh: 他称赞我的外套，我却听成了别的话。
lines.py: tā chēng zàn wǒ de wài tào , wǒ què tīng chéng le bié de huà .
lines.en: He complimented my coat, but I misheard it as something else.

lines.zh: 妈妈称赞我这次做饭有进步。
lines.py: mā mā chēng zàn wǒ zhè cì zuò fàn yǒu jìn bù .
lines.en: Mum said my cooking had improved this time.

lines.zh: 你先解释一下，我再回答。
lines.py: nǐ xiān jiě shì yī xià , wǒ zài huí dá .
lines.en: Explain first, then I’ll answer.

lines.zh: 她用两张照片解释了路线。
lines.py: tā yòng liǎng zhāng zhào piān jiě shì le lù xiàn .
lines.en: She explained the route using two photos.

lines.zh: 老师当着全班表扬了她。
lines.py: lǎo shī dāng zhe quán bān biǎo yáng le tā .
lines.en: The teacher praised her in front of the whole class.

lines.zh: 他不习惯被表扬，脸一下就红了。
lines.py: tā bù xí guàn bèi biǎo yáng , liǎn yī xià jiù hóng le .
lines.en: He wasn’t used to being praised and immediately blushed.

lines.zh: 我不在乎坐哪里，只要能听清楚。
lines.py: wǒ bù zài hū zuò nǎ lǐ , zhǐ yào néng tīng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: I don’t mind where I sit as long as I can hear.

lines.zh: 她不在乎输赢，只想跟朋友一起玩。
lines.py: tā bù zài hū shū yíng , zhǐ xiǎng gēn péng you yì qǐ wán .
lines.en: She doesn’t care about winning or losing; she just wants to play with friends.

lines.zh: 迟到几分钟不要紧，到了给我发消息。
lines.py: chí dào jǐ fēn zhōng bú yào jǐn , dào le gěi wǒ fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: A few minutes late is fine; message me when you arrive.

lines.zh: 杯子打破了？不要紧，你没受伤吧？
lines.py: bēi zi dǎ pò le ? bú yào jǐn , nǐ méi shòu shāng ba ?
lines.en: You broke the cup? It’s all right. Are you hurt?

conversation.title: A compliment or a joke?
conversation.context: You are unsure whether a comment about your coat was friendly.
conversation.goal: Check the intended meaning of an ambiguous remark

partner.name: 陈宇
partner.persona: A familiar classmate; friendly, brief replies.

turns.pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shì shén me yì si ?
turns.meaning: What did you mean just now?
examples: 我是真心称赞你，颜色很好看。
accept: ^我是真心称赞你，颜色很好看。[。！？]?$

turns.text: 你是不是不喜欢这个话题？
turns.pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí ?
turns.intent: Say that the topic is fine but you misheard
examples: 不是，我只是误会你的意思了。
accept: ^不是，我只是误会你的意思了。[。！？]?$

turns.pinyin: nà wǒ men jìn qù ba ?

natural.py: nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào , duì ba ?

pragmatics.note: Use a light delivery when checking friendly teasing; the same words can sound challenging if stressed.

natural.zh: 是我误会了，谢谢你解释。
natural.py: shì wǒ wù huì le , xiè xiè nǐ jiě shì .

pragmatics.note: This addresses your reading of the remark without claiming everyone must share it.

audio.zh: 我真是在称赞你。我这个人一紧张就不太会笑。
audio.py: wǒ zhēn shì zài chēng zàn nǐ . wǒ zhè gè rén yī jǐn zhāng jiù bù tài huì xiào .
audio.en: I really was complimenting you. I find it hard to smile when I’m nervous.

tasks.statement: The speaker says nervousness makes smiling difficult.
tasks.why: They explicitly describe what happens when nervous.

audio.zh: 他没有发火，只问我究竟把票放在哪里。我承认自己出门前没检查，马上打车回去拿。
audio.py: tā méi yǒu fā huǒ , zhǐ wèn wǒ jiū jìng bǎ piào fàng zài nǎ lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ chū mén qián méi jiǎn chá , mǎ shàng dǎ chē huí qù ná .
audio.en: He didn’t lose his temper, just asked where exactly I’d put the tickets. I admitted I hadn’t checked before leaving and immediately took a taxi home to collect them.

tasks.statement: The narrator immediately blamed the friend for losing the tickets.
tasks.why: They admitted not checking before leaving.

prompt.zh: 你说我的外套挺好看，究竟是什么意思？
prompt.py: nǐ shuō wǒ de wài tào tǐng hǎo kàn , jiū jìng shì shén me yì si ?
prompt.en: You said my coat looks good. What exactly do you mean?

choices: 我是在称赞你的外套。
我是说这件外套不好看。
我只说不好看，没有说好看。
tasks.why: This clarifies the remark under discussion.

prompt.zh: 票还在家里，我们现在在车站，家里可能有人。怎么办？
prompt.py: piào hái zài jiā lǐ , wǒ men xiàn zài zài chē zhàn , jiā lǐ kě néng yǒu rén . zěn me bàn ?
prompt.en: The tickets are at home and we are at the station. Someone may be home. What can we do?

choices: 先问问家里有没有人。
我们已经拿到票，可以直接上车。
票不在家里，你刚才说带来了。
tasks.why: The reply offers a practical next step.

line.zh: 这家店的面【的确】很好吃。
line.py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn dí què hěn hǎo chī .
line.en: The noodles here really are good.
